sheets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production overhead pixel-art boss sprite sheet for DEAD ZONE. Match the supplied reference's gritty pixel art, dark outlines, muted diseased green skin, readable clustered highlights and exact TOP-DOWN camera looking vertically down onto heads and shoulders. New boss design, reference is style/camera only. All poses face EAST (right), including corpses. Never side view or front view. Transparent background with actual alpha. Square image, EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows of equal square cells, 16 sprites, no margins between cells, no labels, no grid lines, no text, no floor, no shadow. Each creature centered on the same cell anchor, consistent body scale, maximum footprint 80% of cell, clear padding on all sides, do not let extremities cross cells. Crisp pixel clusters, no blur/soft glow/3D render.
Cell order left to right then down:
row1: idle breathing frame1, idle breathing frame2, walk left step, walk passing.
row2: walk right step, walk passing alternate, melee attack wind back, melee attack strike forwards.
row3: special preparation crouch, special preparation brace, special release frame1, special release frame2.
row4: hit recoil/stunned, death collapse start, death collapse middle, dead body lying flat viewed overhead.
The last 3 poses must clearly collapse onto ground but stay facing east. No particles or detached projectiles baked into poses.
Subject: The Butcher: huge stocky undead male, moss green skin, dirty ivory butcher apron with dark dried-red stains and broad brown leather straps visible over back, charcoal pants and boots, huge square steel meat cleaver held in right hand. Thick neck, bald head, muscular arms. Special preparation lowers head and braces cleaver, special release charging headfirst with shoulders forward. Cleaver present in all living frames. Muted blood-red and cream identity.
